notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics company building an in-app chat assistant + background agents that call internal tools (calendar, DB lookups, CRM notes). Prefers to start on Hosted API for speed of integration; evaluating Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation after initial POC. Key quote from CTO: "We cannot ship anything that risks PII in logs — must be redacted before it lands in your telemetry."

Sales/Discovery highlights:
- Evaluating for chat/agent workloads: streaming responses + tool calling required.
- Latency SLOs: first-token start <=200ms p95; subsequent token latency target <50ms p95 for interactive feel.
- Concurrency expectation: 300-500 active concurrent users; peak request concurrency ~60-80 rps during schedules.
- Cost sensitivity moderate: will trade some cost for reliability but needs predictable unit economics for budgeting.
- Model preference: OSS fine (Llama derivatives / Mistral-style) for cost; may use Redwood curated variants or smaller fallback models.
- Security: SSO/SAML mandatory, SOC2 attestation required for procurement, KMS integration (customer-managed keys) for secrets, audit logs retained 13 months, data residency in us-west required for subset of PII.
- Logging: want redact-at-ingest or tokenization removal for PII; no raw prompt storage with user PII. Ask: can Redwood provide pre-log hooks or server-side redaction?

Previous touchpoints:
- 2026-01-22: Demo (hosted API streaming + function calling) — demo recording + Fireflies id attached. AE demoed streaming start-of-stream and function calls to calendar.
- 2026-02-18: Security deep-dive with SecOps and Eng (requested SOC2 docs, network diagram).
- 2026-02-28: POC kickoff: agreed on 2-week hosted API POC (traffic cap, synthetic scenarios).
- 2026-03-03: POC mid-point check-in — observed cold-start latency spikes; discussed autoscaling and warm pools.

Stated requirements / success criteria for POC:
- Integration: tool-calling working end-to-end (calendar + DB) with function-calling hooks.
- Latency: 1st-token p95 <=200ms, stable per-token after warm-up.
- Security: SOC2 docs submitted and accepted; SSO working in staging; redaction pipeline validated on sample prompts.
- Cost: projected monthly dev+prod spend under $25k for hosted POC; committed to consider Dedicated if cost per 1M tokens with batching < threshold.
